title: MA-Mesh: Resilient Multi-Agent Collaboration via Role-based Self-Healing
title_zh: MA-Mesh：基于角色的自愈式弹性多智能体协作

paragraphs.en: Effective collaboration in multi-agent systems requires mechanisms for coordination and adaptability in dynamic and uncertain environments. However, existing multi-agent systems rarely model resilience explicitly, instead relying on ad-hoc output correction that limits systematic, runtime management of robustness. In this work, we propose Multi-Agent Mesh (MA-Mesh), a framework that constructs a role-based self-healing layer on top of a collaboration pattern. Specifically, MA-Mesh generates resilience-aware system specifications and synthesizes them into executable multi-agent policy code. To enhance resilience, we introduce two self-healing mechanisms: Cross-agent reflection, a mechanism that allows agents to evaluate not only their own outcomes but also the performance of their peers, enabling informed behavioral adjustments and collective policy refinement; Role-based failover, a strategy which dynamically reassigns roles and enables agents to substitute for one another when sub-tasks fail or agents underperform, ensuring continuity of task execution. Experimental results across diverse tasks (e.g., software development, tool use, scientific reasoning) demonstrate that MA-Mesh significantly outperforms existing multi-agent systems in both task performance and robustness under system uncertainty.

paragraphs.en: To address this, we draw inspiration from the cloud service mesh Li et al. (2019) to automate the construction of resilient multi-agent systems that can be instantiated dynamically on top of a collaboration pattern. Specifically, we explicitly decouple the collaboration logic, which governs task execution, from the resilience policy, which materializes a role-based self-healing layer. The self-healing layer operates through two mechanisms: (i) cross-agent reflection, which evaluates an agent’s own outcomes or those of its peers against its role-specific requirements to detect performance degradation; (ii) role-based failover, which continuously monitors agent execution and substitutes an affected agent with a suitable alternative when reflection signals performance degradation or a response timeout occurs. Such a design directly parallels a service mesh, where sidecar proxies transparently provide a resilience layer to microservices.

paragraphs.en: To this end, we present the Multi-Agent Mesh ( MA-Mesh ) framework, which overlays a role-based self-healing layer on top of a collaboration pattern, yielding a resilient multi-agent system. Given a task, an LLM orchestrator generates a resilience-aware system specification in a structured format. The specification comprises collaboration logic, which is either a user-supplied or an orchestrator-generated workflow, and a cross-agent reflection mechanism, which specifies the peers to evaluate and the role-specific criteria for assessing their execution outcomes. The orchestrator then synthesizes the executable code by instantiating pre-defined agent and resilient proxy classes from this specification. A resilient proxy is attached to each agent; collectively, these proxies realize the self-healing layer. The role-based failover mechanism is built into the resilient proxy class, which monitors agent execution and triggers recovery upon performance degradation (detected by cross-agent reflection) or response timeout. Once triggered, a dedicated meta-agent replaces the affected agent and reassigns its role, ensuring execution continuity without global re-orchestration.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了多智能体网格（MA-Mesh）框架，该框架在协作模式之上叠加一个基于角色的自愈层，从而构建出一个有韧性的多智能体系统。 给定一项任务，一个 LLM 编排器会以结构化格式生成一份感知韧性的系统规范。 该规范包含协作逻辑（由用户提供或由编排器生成的工作流），以及跨智能体反思机制（指定由哪些智能体进行评估，以及评估其执行结果时采用的基于角色的标准）。 随后，编排器通过依据该规范实例化预定义的智能体类和韧性代理类，合成可执行的代码。 每个智能体都附加一个韧性代理；这些代理共同实现了自愈层。 基于角色的故障转移机制内置于韧性代理类中，它监控智能体的执行，并在性能下降（由跨智能体反思检测）或响应超时时触发恢复。 一旦被触发，一个专用的元智能体会替换受影响的智能体并重新分配其角色，从而在不进行全局重新编排的情况下保证执行的连续性。

paragraphs.en: Through evaluations on software development for GUI and web applications Liu et al. (2025) ; Hu et al. (2025b) , tool-use tasks Mialon et al. (2024) , and scientific reasoning Rein et al. (2023) , we demonstrate that MA-Mesh substantially improves the resilience of multi-agent systems. We evaluate under four system uncertainty scenarios Netflix (2012) that model partial and behavioral uncertainty: agent chaos, prompt chaos, I/O chaos, and compound chaos. Across these settings, MA-Mesh consistently outperforms the strongest baseline C+I Huang et al. (2025) , with an average accuracy gain of 32.51 percentage points (pp). We further evaluate detection recall (DR), the fraction of affected agents correctly identified by resilient proxies, and observe an average improvement of 0.36 0.36 in DR over C+I. Moreover, to validate MA-Mesh ’s adaptability to arbitrary collaboration patterns, we overlay it on top of MetaGPT Hong et al. (2024) and RTADev Liu et al. (2025) , observing an average accuracy gain of 43.74 43.74 pp and 29.42 29.42 pp, respectively (see Table 5 ). Lastly, we validate MA-Mesh on AIOpsLab Chen et al. (2025) , a cloud-native testbed, demonstrating its practical applicability beyond synthetic chaos scenarios. The contributions of our work are summarized as follows:

paragraphs.en: We introduce resilient proxies to realize the self-healing layer, comprising cross-agent reflection for role-specific degradation detection and role-based failover for recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入弹性代理来实现自愈层，包括用于角色特定降级检测的跨智能体反思，以及用于恢复的基于角色的故障转移。

paragraphs.en: Through experiments on benchmarks including software development, tool use, and scientific reasoning, we demonstrate that MA-Mesh outperforms existing multi-agent systems under diverse system uncertainty scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 通过在软件开发、工具使用和科学推理等基准测试上的实验，我们证明了 MA-Mesh 在多种系统不确定性场景下优于现有多智能体系统。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems have been widely adopted across diverse domains, including software development Hong et al. (2024) ; Liu et al. (2025) , scientific discovery Kim et al. (2025a) ; Schmidgall et al. (2025) , and complex mathematical reasoning Du et al. (2024) ; Lei et al. (2024) . In parallel, several works Chen et al. (2024b) ; Chen et al. (2024a) automate the configuration of multi-agent systems, dynamically adapting agent roles and coordination structures via an LLM orchestrator. Yet, these approaches assume nominal operating conditions and rarely address system-level resilience. Recently, NetSafe Yu et al. (2025) analyzes which coordination structures are inherently robust under adversarial attacks, while C+I Huang et al. (2025) explicitly handles errors through challenger and inspector agents. However, C+I remains limited to correction-based mitigation, lacking role-aware evaluation and reconfiguration. In contrast, MA-Mesh provides a service-mesh-style framework that augments any collaboration pattern with two mechanisms: cross-agent reflection, whose evaluation scope and criteria are dynamically determined, and role-based failover, which reconfigures agents at runtime upon failures or performance degradation.

paragraphs.en: In real-world deployments, multi-agent systems are exposed to diverse sources of system uncertainty, such as network or hardware failures, imperfect agent behavior, and adversarial interventions. To model such uncertainty, we adopt chaos engineering practices Netflix (2012) ; Chaos Mesh (2021) which inject stochastic perturbations during system execution. Concretely, we consider three primitive classes of perturbations: agent chaos , which captures agent termination due to network or hardware faults; prompt chaos , which models errors in the agent prompts; and I/O chaos , which captures partial corruption of agent-generated outputs during transmission.
paragraphs.zh: 在真实世界的部署中，多智能体系统会暴露于多种系统不确定性来源，例如网络或硬件故障、不完善的智能体行为以及对抗性干预。 为了对这种不确定性建模，我们采用 Netflix (2012)；Chaos Mesh (2021) 的混沌工程实践，在系统执行期间注入随机扰动。 具体而言，我们考虑三类基本扰动：智能体混沌（agent chaos），刻画因网络或硬件故障导致的智能体终止；提示词混沌（prompt chaos），建模智能体提示词中的错误；以及 I/O 混沌（I/O chaos），刻画智能体生成的输出在传输过程中的部分损坏。

paragraphs.en: To automate the construction of resilient multi-agent systems, we present the MA-Mesh framework comprising two stages: (i) resilience-aware system specification , and (ii) multi-agent policy code synthesis , as illustrated on the left side of Figure 1 . In (i), an LLM orchestrator derives a structured specification that consists of the collaboration logic and the cross-agent reflection mechanism. The collaboration logic specifies the sub-task decomposition, the coordination structure, and the agent roles. As a default, it is dynamically generated by the orchestrator, but it can also be adopted from a predefined collaboration pattern of an existing static multi-agent system. Cross-agent reflection associates each agent with a resilient proxy that specifies the reflection target and criteria. At runtime, these proxies assess the outcomes produced by peer agents and provide feedback accordingly. In (ii), given the resulting specification, the orchestrator synthesizes executable multi-agent policy code by instantiating the agents and resilient proxies as parameterized classes. In doing so, the role-based failover mechanism is embedded into the resilient proxies, which trigger failover upon detecting runtime execution failures or suboptimal agent behavior, prompting the meta-agent to replace the affected agent.
paragraphs.zh: 为实现韧性多智能体系统的自动化构建，我们提出MA-Mesh框架，该框架包含两个阶段：(i) 韧性感知的系统规约，以及 (ii) 多智能体策略代码合成，如图1左侧所示。 在阶段 (i) 中，一个LLM编排器推导出一个结构化规约，该规约由协作逻辑和跨智能体反思机制组成。 协作逻辑规定了子任务分解、协调结构以及智能体角色。 作为默认方式，协作逻辑由编排器动态生成，但也可以采用自现有静态多智能体系统中预定义的协作模式。 跨智能体反思为每个智能体关联一个韧性代理，该代理规定了反思的目标与标准。 在运行时，这些代理评估对等智能体产生的结果，并据此提供反馈。 在阶段 (ii) 中，基于所得到的规约，编排器通过将智能体和韧性代理实例化为参数化类来合成可执行的多智能体策略代码。 通过这种方式，基于角色的故障转移机制被嵌入到韧性代理中，这些代理在检测到运行时执行失败或次优的智能体行为时触发故障转移，促使元智能体替换受影响的智能体。

sents.en: Each proxy encodes a cross-agent reflection mechanism that specifies (1) the reflection targets, which are the agents whose outputs it evaluates, and (2) reflection criteria, which capture both output quality and role-level expectations from the reflecting agent’s perspective.
sents.zh: 每个代理编码了一种跨智能体反思机制，该机制规定了（1）反思目标，即其评估其输出的智能体；以及（2）反思准则，即从反思智能体的视角同时捕捉输出质量和角色级期望。

sents.en: Note that a reflection target may belong to a different sub-task, and if an agent is selected by no other agent, its resilient proxy performs self-reflection by default.
sents.zh: 注意，反思目标可能属于不同的子任务，并且如果某个智能体未被任何其他智能体选中，其弹性代理默认执行自我反思。

paragraphs.en: Resilient proxy: role-based failover. The role-based failover mechanism is built into the resilient proxy class, so code synthesis simply instantiates proxies already equipped to detect failover conditions and initiate agent replacement. The replacement is handled by a dedicated meta-agent that does not itself participate in task execution. To replace an agent identified as faulty or degraded, the meta-agent initializes a new agent with a refined role specification. Role-based failover is triggered under two conditions. (i) The resilient proxy enforces a response timeout to regulate each agent’s execution. If an agent fails to respond within this limit, the proxy triggers failover. (ii) Failover is also triggered when the cross-agent reflection repeatedly identifies that an agent fails to satisfy the specified reflection criteria, with the number of failed attempts exceeding a predefined retry threshold. As a result, role-based failover enables the system to dynamically recover from both runtime execution failures and suboptimal agent behaviors, ensuring resilient task execution without re-orchestrating the entire multi-agent system.

paragraphs.en: Conceptually, the resulting resilient multi-agent system follows a service-mesh-like architecture, comprising a control plane and a data plane. The resilience-aware system specification serves as the control plane artifact, encoding collaboration logic and cross-agent reflection. At runtime, the meta-agent residing in the control plane leverages this specification to instantiate appropriate replacement agents, preserving the continuity of task execution. The data plane consists of the agents and resilient proxies instantiated from the synthesized multi-agent code. The agents are responsible for task execution, while resilient proxies enforce the encoded role-based self-healing mechanisms by monitoring agent execution, applying timeout constraints, performing cross-agent reflection, and triggering role-based failover when necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 从概念上讲，由此得到的弹性多智能体系统遵循类服务网格（service-mesh-like）架构，由控制平面和数据平面组成。 具备弹性感知的系统规范作为控制平面的制品，编码了协作逻辑和跨智能体反思。 在运行时，驻留在控制平面中的元智能体利用该规范来实例化合适的替代智能体，从而保持任务执行的连续性。 数据平面由从合成的多智能体代码中实例化出来的智能体和弹性代理组成。 智能体负责任务执行，而弹性代理则通过监控智能体执行、施加超时约束、执行跨智能体反思以及在必要时触发基于角色的故障转移，来强制执行已编码的基于角色的自愈机制。

paragraphs.en: In these experiments, CoT yields zero accuracy under agent chaos, since any single-point failure directly terminates task execution. In contrast, multi-agent systems are generally more robust, as failures of individual agents can be partially compensated for by other agents. Yet, MetaGPT, LLM-Debate, and EvoMAC show limited performance, lacking explicit mechanisms to detect and recover from system uncertainty. C+I and RTADev improve performance by incorporating self-correction: C+I introduces dedicated inspector and challenger agents to detect and correct erroneous outputs, while RTADev evaluates each new outcome against prior ones to refine faulty outcomes and maintain alignment across execution steps. Unlike these correction-based mechanisms, MA-Mesh performs cross-agent reflection to assess agents from the perspectives of their peers and addresses failures by replacing agents through role-based failover. As a result, the resilient proxies in MA-Mesh function as infrastructure-level resilience mechanisms that mitigate error propagation and enforce role-based recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些实验中，CoT 在智能体混乱下准确率为零，因为任何单点故障都会直接终止任务执行。 相比之下，多智能体系统通常更加稳健，因为个别智能体的故障可以被其他智能体部分补偿。 然而，MetaGPT、LLM-Debate 和 EvoMAC 的性能有限，缺乏检测系统不确定性并从中恢复的显式机制。 C+I 和 RTADev 通过引入自我纠正来提升性能：C+I 引入专门的检查者（inspector）和质疑者（challenger）智能体来检测并纠正错误输出，而 RTADev 将每个新结果与先前结果进行对比评估，以修正有缺陷的结果并保持各执行步骤之间的一致性。 与这些基于纠正的机制不同，MA-Mesh 执行跨智能体反思，从同伴的视角评估各个智能体，并通过基于角色的故障转移替换智能体来应对故障。 因此，MA-Mesh 中的韧性代理作为基础设施级的韧性机制，能够缓解错误传播并实施基于角色的恢复。

paragraphs.en: Varying Chaos Conditions. Table 2 reports the performance of RTADev, C+I, and MA-Mesh under varying chaos conditions on both software development benchmarks. For Agent Chaos, we vary its severity via termination ratios of 20%, 40%, and 60%. As the termination ratio increases, accuracy degrades sharply for the baselines, while MA-Mesh maintains robust performance across all severity levels. This is due to role-based failover in MA-Mesh , which detects failures through timeouts and replaces the affected agents. For Prompt Chaos, we apply three perturbation types, namely random word replacement, deletion, and shuffling, and MA-Mesh consistently outperforms the baselines in all cases. Since agents are not merely response generators but actors with explicitly assigned roles, correction-based baselines are less effective under prompt corruption. In contrast, MA-Mesh explicitly assesses peer outcomes with role-aware reflection criteria and recovers compromised agents via role-based failover, thereby showing improved performance. For I/O Chaos, we apply the same perturbations as Prompt Chaos, and MA-Mesh again outperforms the baselines. C+I occasionally attains higher DR than MA-Mesh because its correction-based strategy over-detects affected agents. When an output is perturbed, part of its semantic content remains intact; MA-Mesh ’s cross-agent reflection filters out such cases, while C+I still flags them as failures. As a result, although C+I exhibits higher DR in some settings, this gain comes at the cost of substantially lower accuracy than MA-Mesh .

Ablation on Resilient Proxy. Table 7 presents the impact of removing cross-agent reflection, role-based failover, and the full resilient proxy on the Web Dev., with all variants using the same synthesized workflow as MA-Mesh . Even under the vanilla setting, removing these components degrades performance, since MA-Mesh detects and mitigates errors from both suboptimal role assignment by the orchestrator and hallucinated agent outputs. The degradation becomes more pronounced under Compound Chaos. In this work, we presented the MA-Mesh framework for constructing resilient multi-agent systems that systematically address partial failures and behavioral uncertainty. By decoupling collaboration logic from resilience policy in a structured specification, MA-Mesh synthesizes executable code that overlays a role-based self-healing layer on top of a collaboration pattern. This layer is realized through resilient proxies which integrate cross-agent reflection for role-specific degradation detection with role-based failover for recovery. Through extensive experiments on diverse system uncertainty scenarios, together with a case study on a cloud-native testbed, we demonstrate that MA-Mesh consistently outperforms existing multi-agent systems in both task performance and resilience.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 MA-Mesh 框架，用于构建能够系统性应对部分故障和行为不确定性的弹性多智能体系统。 通过在结构化规范中将协作逻辑与弹性策略解耦，MA-Mesh 综合生成可执行代码，在协作模式之上叠加一层基于角色的自愈层。 该层通过弹性代理实现，弹性代理将用于角色特定退化检测的跨智能体反思与用于恢复的基于角色的故障转移相结合。 通过在多样化系统不确定性场景上的大量实验，以及在一个云原生测试平台上的案例研究，我们证明 MA-Mesh 在任务性能和弹性两方面均持续优于现有的多智能体系统。

paragraphs.en: This work seeks to characterize and reduce failure modes in LLM-based multi-agent collaboration, enabling more robust orchestration. The chaos engineering techniques introduced in this study serve as experimental tools to evaluate the resilience of multi-agent systems through stochastic perturbations that simulate system uncertainty. Although these techniques could potentially be exploited to disrupt agent behaviors or corrupt outputs, such risks are mitigated by resilience mechanisms designed to detect uncertainty. To ensure transparency and reproducibility, a detailed description of each chaos scenario is provided in Appendix D.1 . These techniques are intended solely for defensive evaluation and academic research, and should not be used to enable malicious interference.

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent System. LLM-based multi-agent systems have emerged as an effective paradigm for solving complex tasks by assigning specialized roles to multiple agents and coordinating their interactions. Existing systems often encode such collaboration through manually designed roles, task handoffs, and communication protocols. LLM-Debate Du et al. (2024) adopts a solver-judge debate structure, where solver agents independently generate responses, iteratively critique one another, and a judge agent synthesizes the final answer. MetaGPT Hong et al. (2024) formalizes software development as an SOP-based workflow, where fixed roles such as product manager, architect, engineer, and QA engineer sequentially exchange artifacts across development stages. RTADev Liu et al. (2025) extends this static development workflow with intention-alignment checks, where reviewer agents inspect intermediate artifacts and trigger discussion when downstream outputs diverge from prior role intents. While this role-based design enables structured collaboration, static coordination structures make it difficult to adapt the system beyond predefined task scopes. Accordingly, AgentVerse Chen et al. (2024b) automates agent-team coordination through dynamic expert recruitment, collaborative decision-making, action execution, and evaluation. AutoAgents Chen et al. (2024a) dynamically generates specialized agents from task content and coordinates them through task-specific planning. AFlow Zhang et al. (2025b) represents agentic workflows as executable code and optimizes them through Monte Carlo Tree Search with execution feedback. MaAS Zhang et al. (2025a) searches over an agentic supernet to sample query-dependent multi-agent architectures with task-specific resource allocation. EvoMAC Hu et al. (2025b) self-evolves multi-agent collaboration networks by converting execution feedback into textual gradients that update agent prompts, connections, and workflows during test-time execution. However, these methods assume nominal system conditions and do not explicitly address failures or behavioral uncertainty during runtime. In contrast, MA-Mesh extends a collaboration pattern with resilience policies for runtime monitoring and recovery under system uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体系统。 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统已成为解决复杂任务的一种有效范式，其做法是为多个智能体分配专门角色并协调它们之间的交互。 现有系统通常通过人工设计的角色、任务交接和通信协议来编码这种协作。LLM-Debate（Du 等人， 2024）采用求解者-裁判的辩论结构，其中求解者智能体独立生成回答、迭代地相互批评，由裁判智能体综合出最终答案。MetaGPT（Hong 等人， 2024）将软件开发形式化为基于标准作业流程（SOP）的工作流，其中产品经理、架构师、工程师和 QA 工程师等固定角色在各个开发阶段按顺序交换产物。RTADev（Liu 等人， 2025）在这一静态开发工作流的基础上扩展了意图对齐检查，其中审阅者智能体检查中间产物，并在下游输出偏离先前角色意图时触发讨论。 虽然这种基于角色的设计实现了结构化协作，但静态的协调结构使系统难以适应预定义任务范围之外的情形。 因此，AgentVerse（Chen 等人， 2024b）通过动态专家招募、协作决策、行动执行和评估来自动化智能体团队的协调。AutoAgents（Chen 等人， 2024a）根据任务内容动态生成专门的智能体，并通过针对任务的规划来协调它们。AFlow（Zhang 等人， 2025b）将智能体工作流表示为可执行代码，并通过带执行反馈的蒙特卡洛树搜索对其进行优化。MaAS（Zhang 等人， 2025a）在智能体超网络上进行搜索，以采样依赖查询的多智能体架构并进行针对任务的资源分配。EvoMAC（Hu 等人， 2025b）通过将执行反馈转化为文本梯度来更新智能体提示词、连接和工作流，使多智能体协作网络在测试时执行期间自我演化。 然而，这些方法都假设系统处于正常运行状态，并未显式处理运行时的故障或行为不确定性。 相比之下，MA-Mesh 在协作模式的基础上扩展了韧性策略，以在系统不确定性下实现运行时监控与恢复。

paragraphs.en: Cloud Native Resilience. Resilience has long been a fundamental design consideration in large-scale cloud and distributed systems Basiri et al. (2016) ; Taleb et al. (2016) . In particular, the service mesh Li et al. (2019) has emerged as a principled architectural approach to achieve system-level resilience by decoupling resilience logic from microservice applications. The service mesh explicitly separates a control plane, which manages resilience policies through declarative configurations, from a data plane, where sidecar proxies attached to microservices intercept service-to-service communication and provide fault-tolerance mechanisms such as retries, timeouts, and circuit breaking Homer et al. (2014) . MA-Mesh adapts this cloud-native principle to multi-agent systems through an infrastructure-as-code (IaC) approach Morris (2016) . In this sense, the artifact constructed through IaC is a service-mesh-style infrastructure, where synthesized policy code instantiates sidecar-like resilient proxies around task-executing agents. This enables infrastructure-level enforcement of resilience policies for multi-agent systems, without embedding resilience logic directly into agent implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 云原生韧性。 韧性长期以来一直是大规模云与分布式系统中的基础设计考量 Basiri et al. (2016)；Taleb et al. (2016)。 特别是，服务网格 Li et al. (2019) 已成为一种原则性的架构方法，通过将韧性逻辑与微服务应用解耦来实现系统级韧性。 服务网格显式地将控制平面与数据平面分离：控制平面通过声明式配置管理韧性策略；数据平面中，附着在微服务上的边车代理拦截服务间通信，并提供重试、超时和熔断等容错机制 Homer et al. (2014)。 MA-Mesh 通过基础设施即代码（IaC）方法 Morris (2016)，将这一云原生原则适配到多智能体系统。 从这个意义上说，通过 IaC 构建的产物是一种服务网格式的基础设施，其中合成的策略代码在执行任务的智能体周围实例化类似边车的韧性代理。 这使得多智能体系统的韧性策略可以在基础设施层面强制执行，而无需将韧性逻辑直接嵌入智能体实现中。

paragraphs.en: Large-scale applications are often deployed as cloud-native microservices, where inter-service dependencies allow partial failures to propagate across downstream services. Such failure propagation motivates the evaluation of system-level resilience – the system’s capability to maintain service availability despite failures in individual services. Chaos engineering evaluates this resilience by injecting controlled failures into target services during execution, such as service crashes, network disruptions, and timeouts.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模应用通常以云原生微服务的形式部署，服务间的依赖关系会使部分故障传播到下游服务。 这种故障传播促使人们评估系统级韧性——即系统在个别服务发生故障的情况下仍能维持服务可用性的能力。 混沌工程通过在运行期间向目标服务注入受控故障来评估这种韧性，例如服务崩溃、网络中断和超时。

paragraphs.en: To improve resilience under such failures, a service mesh provides a cloud-native infrastructure layer for managing service-to-service communication and resilience policies. As shown in Figure 4 , the control plane manages these policies, while sidecar proxies in the data plane mediate service interactions and detect partial failures through mechanisms such as retries, timeouts, circuit breaking, failover, and health checking. This separation decouples business logic from resilience logic, enabling runtime failure mitigation without modifying application code.

paragraphs.en: MA-Mesh adopts the control–data plane separation and the sidecar-proxy pattern from service meshes, attaching a resilient proxy to each task-executing agent to mediate inter-agent communication. To adapt this pattern to LLM-based collaboration, cross-agent reflection replaces predefined local health checks with distributed LLM-based evaluation under role-specific criteria. paragraphs.en: Motivated by these observations, we extend FSD-Bench and rSDE-Bench into a new software development benchmark, aiming to better probe state-of-the-art LLMs. The benchmark consists of two task suites – Web Development and GUI Development – derived from rSDE-Bench and FSD-Bench, respectively. Each task is built in two steps. We first expand an original specification into a more demanding one by lengthening the description and increasing the number of functional units to implement. We then use Claude Code Anthropic (2026) to generate the accompanying Selenium-based automated tests. We validate the resulting benchmark on two fronts: correctness and difficulty. For correctness, two authors independently review every specification and test pair, ensuring that each specification is internally consistent and implementable. For difficulty, we quantitatively evaluate the resulting benchmark. As shown in Table 10 , our Web Development tasks are 113% longer with 59% more functional units than rSDE-Bench, while our GUI Development tasks are 1,613% longer with 25% more functional units than FSD-Bench. An example task and its test code are shown in Figure 5 and Figure 6 , respectively.

paragraphs.en: This section details our setup for evaluating the resilience of multi-agent systems, including system uncertainty scenarios, metrics, and tools.
paragraphs.zh: 本节详细介绍了我们用于评估多智能体系统韧性的设置，包括系统不确定性场景、指标和工具。

paragraphs.en: In real-world deployments, multi-agent systems are subject to diverse sources of system-level uncertainty, including hardware failures, network disruptions, and imperfect agent behavior. To systematically assess resilience under such conditions, we design a set of controlled chaos scenarios akin to established chaos engineering practices Netflix (2012) ; Basiri et al. (2016) . Chaos engineering deliberately injects controlled failures into systems to assess recovery mechanisms and identify weaknesses before they manifest in production environments. Following this paradigm, we construct three chaos scenarios— Agent Chaos , Prompt Chaos , I/O Chaos —each simulating a distinct failure mode commonly encountered in LLM-based multi-agent systems. In addition, we define Compound Chaos as a composite scenario in which all these chaos types are simultaneously present. In our experiments, we enforce that each run includes at least one agent affected by the injected chaos, avoiding trivial executions with no failures. Examples of each chaos scenario are illustrated in Figure 9 .
paragraphs.zh: 在真实世界的部署中，多智能体系统面临多种系统级不确定性来源，包括硬件故障、网络中断以及不完善的智能体行为。 为了系统地评估此类条件下的韧性，我们设计了一组受控混沌场景，类似于既有的混沌工程实践 Netflix (2012) ; Basiri et al. (2016) 。 混沌工程通过向系统刻意注入受控故障，以评估恢复机制并在弱点显现于生产环境之前发现它们。 遵循这一范式，我们构建了三种混沌场景—— 智能体混沌 、 提示混沌 、 I/O 混沌 ——每种场景模拟基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中常见的一种不同故障模式。 此外，我们将复合混沌定义为所有这些混沌类型同时存在的复合场景。 在我们的实验中，我们强制要求每次运行至少包含一个受注入混沌影响的智能体，以避免没有任何故障的平凡执行。 各混沌场景的示例如 图 9 所示。

paragraphs.en: Agent Chaos simulates abrupt agent termination resulting from hardware faults, network failures, or process crashes. Inspired by Chaos Monkey ( Netflix, 2012 ) , which randomly terminates service instances to evaluate system resilience, Agent Chaos forcefully interrupts selected agents during task execution. When an agent is targeted, its execution is immediately halted, and no response is returned to downstream agents. This allows subsequent agents to continue execution while reflecting the degraded system state. The termination ratio controls the proportion of agents subject to termination. In our experiments, we set the termination probability to 30%, i.e., each agent is independently terminated with a probability of 30% during its execution cycle. We further conduct a sensitivity analysis by varying this ratio from 20% to 60% to quantify performance degradation under increasing failure severity, as shown in Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体混沌（Agent Chaos）模拟由硬件故障、网络失效或进程崩溃导致的智能体突然终止。 该方法受混沌猴子（Chaos Monkey，Netflix，2012）启发，后者通过随机终止服务实例来评估系统韧性，智能体混沌则在任务执行过程中强制中断选定的智能体。 当某个智能体被选中时，其执行会立即停止，并且不会向下游智能体返回任何响应。 这使得后续智能体能够在继续执行的同时反映出系统的降级状态。 终止比例控制被终止的智能体所占的比例。 在我们的实验中，我们将终止概率设为 30%，即每个智能体在其执行周期内以 30% 的概率被独立终止。 我们进一步通过将该比例从 20% 变化到 60% 进行敏感性分析，以量化失效严重程度增加时的性能退化情况，如表 2 所示。

sents.en: Agent Chaos simulates abrupt agent termination resulting from hardware faults, network failures, or process crashes.
sents.zh: 智能体混沌（Agent Chaos）模拟由硬件故障、网络失效或进程崩溃导致的智能体突然终止。

sents.zh: 当某个智能体被选中时，其执行会立即停止，并且不会向下游智能体返回任何响应。

sents.en: This allows subsequent agents to continue execution while reflecting the degraded system state.
sents.zh: 这使得后续智能体能够在继续执行的同时反映出系统的降级状态。

sents.en: The termination ratio controls the proportion of agents subject to termination.
sents.zh: 终止比例控制被终止的智能体所占的比例。

sents.en: In our experiments, we set the termination probability to 30%, i.e., each agent is independently terminated with a probability of 30% during its execution cycle.
sents.zh: 在我们的实验中，我们将终止概率设为 30%，即每个智能体在其执行周期内以 30% 的概率被独立终止。

sents.en: We further conduct a sensitivity analysis by varying this ratio from 20% to 60% to quantify performance degradation under increasing failure severity, as shown in Table 2 .
sents.zh: 我们进一步通过将该比例从 20% 变化到 60% 进行敏感性分析，以量化失效严重程度增加时的性能退化情况，如表 2 所示。

paragraphs.en: Prompt Chaos simulates degraded prompt quality caused by orchestration errors, encoding faults, or transmission noise. Before invoking the LLM, the prompt is corrupted using one of three perturbation types: (1) Shuffle , which permutes words within the prompt while preserving the word count per line; (2) Deletion , which randomly removes 60% of the words; and (3) Replacement , which substitutes 60% of the words with random alphanumeric strings of identical length. When an agent is selected to be affected by prompt chaos, a perturbation type is sampled uniformly at random and applied consistently to all LLM calls issued by that agent. The corruption ratio specifies the proportion of agents subjected to prompt corruption. By default, we set the corruption ratio to 20%.
paragraphs.zh: Prompt Chaos 用于模拟由编排错误、编码故障或传输噪声导致的提示词质量退化。 在调用 LLM 之前，会使用三种扰动类型之一对提示词进行破坏：(1) Shuffle，在保持每行词数不变的前提下对提示词中的词进行重新排列；(2) Deletion，随机删除 60% 的词；以及 (3) Replacement，将 60% 的词替换为长度相同的随机字母数字字符串。 当某个智能体被选中受到 prompt chaos 影响时，会以均匀随机方式采样一种扰动类型，并一致地应用于该智能体发出的所有 LLM 调用。 破坏比例指定了遭受提示词破坏的智能体所占的比例。 默认情况下，我们将破坏比例设置为 20%。

sents.en: Prompt Chaos simulates degraded prompt quality caused by orchestration errors, encoding faults, or transmission noise.
sents.zh: Prompt Chaos 用于模拟由编排错误、编码故障或传输噪声导致的提示词质量退化。

sents.en: Before invoking the LLM, the prompt is corrupted using one of three perturbation types: (1) Shuffle , which permutes words within the prompt while preserving the word count per line; (2) Deletion , which randomly removes 60% of the words; and (3) Replacement , which substitutes 60% of the words with random alphanumeric strings of identical length.
sents.zh: 在调用 LLM 之前，会使用三种扰动类型之一对提示词进行破坏：(1) Shuffle，在保持每行词数不变的前提下对提示词中的词进行重新排列；(2) Deletion，随机删除 60% 的词；以及 (3) Replacement，将 60% 的词替换为长度相同的随机字母数字字符串。

sents.en: When an agent is selected to be affected by prompt chaos, a perturbation type is sampled uniformly at random and applied consistently to all LLM calls issued by that agent.
sents.zh: 当某个智能体被选中受到 prompt chaos 影响时，会以均匀随机方式采样一种扰动类型，并一致地应用于该智能体发出的所有 LLM 调用。

sents.en: The corruption ratio specifies the proportion of agents subjected to prompt corruption.
sents.zh: 破坏比例指定了遭受提示词破坏的智能体所占的比例。

sents.en: By default, we set the corruption ratio to 20%.
sents.zh: 默认情况下，我们将破坏比例设置为 20%。

paragraphs.en: I/O Chaos simulates corruption during inter-agent communication, capturing failure modes such as hallucinated artifacts produced by LLM agents or message transmission errors. After an agent produces its artifacts, I/O Chaos corrupts the content before it is consumed by subsequent agents, using the same three perturbation types as Prompt Chaos. By default, we set the corruption ratio to 20%.
paragraphs.zh: I/O Chaos 模拟智能体间通信过程中的损坏，捕捉诸如 LLM 智能体产生的幻觉式伪内容或消息传输错误等失效模式。 在智能体产生其输出内容后，I/O Chaos 会在后续智能体消费该内容之前对其进行损坏，使用与 Prompt Chaos 相同的三种扰动类型。 默认情况下，我们将损坏比例设置为 20%。

sents.en: I/O Chaos simulates corruption during inter-agent communication, capturing failure modes such as hallucinated artifacts produced by LLM agents or message transmission errors.
sents.zh: I/O Chaos 模拟智能体间通信过程中的损坏，捕捉诸如 LLM 智能体产生的幻觉式伪内容或消息传输错误等失效模式。

sents.en: After an agent produces its artifacts, I/O Chaos corrupts the content before it is consumed by subsequent agents, using the same three perturbation types as Prompt Chaos.
sents.zh: 在智能体产生其输出内容后，I/O Chaos 会在后续智能体消费该内容之前对其进行损坏，使用与 Prompt Chaos 相同的三种扰动类型。

sents.en: By default, we set the corruption ratio to 20%.
sents.zh: 默认情况下，我们将损坏比例设置为 20%。

paragraphs.en: Compound Chaos combines Agent Chaos , Prompt Chaos , and I/O Chaos to simulate settings in which multiple failure modes occur concurrently. For each agent, the three chaos types are sampled independently. This scenario induces cascading effects across the workflow. For instance, an agent may first operate under corrupted instructions due to Prompt Chaos, and its outputs may be further corrupted by I/O Chaos before being consumed by subsequent agents. By default, we set the probability of each chaos type to 20%.
paragraphs.zh: Compound Chaos 组合了智能体混沌、提示混沌和 I/O 混沌，以模拟多种故障模式同时发生的场景。 对于每个智能体，三种混沌类型被独立采样。 该场景会在整个工作流中引发级联效应。 例如，某个智能体可能首先在因提示混沌而损坏的指令下运行，其输出在被后续智能体消费之前还可能进一步受到 I/O 混沌的破坏。 默认情况下，我们将每种混沌类型的概率设置为 20%。

sents.en: Compound Chaos combines Agent Chaos , Prompt Chaos , and I/O Chaos to simulate settings in which multiple failure modes occur concurrently.
sents.zh: Compound Chaos 组合了智能体混沌、提示混沌和 I/O 混沌，以模拟多种故障模式同时发生的场景。

sents.en: For each agent, the three chaos types are sampled independently.
sents.zh: 对于每个智能体，三种混沌类型被独立采样。

sents.en: This scenario induces cascading effects across the workflow.
sents.zh: 该场景会在整个工作流中引发级联效应。

sents.en: For instance, an agent may first operate under corrupted instructions due to Prompt Chaos, and its outputs may be further corrupted by I/O Chaos before being consumed by subsequent agents.
sents.zh: 例如，某个智能体可能首先在因提示混沌而损坏的指令下运行，其输出在被后续智能体消费之前还可能进一步受到 I/O 混沌的破坏。

sents.en: By default, we set the probability of each chaos type to 20%.
sents.zh: 默认情况下，我们将每种混沌类型的概率设置为 20%。

paragraphs.en: We construct adversarial attack scenarios He et al. (2025) ; Xie et al. (2025) to evaluate the resilience of multi-agent systems against external attacks from malicious agents. Specifically, we consider three classes of adversarial attacks: role prompt attack, task prompt attack, and output attack.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建对抗攻击场景 He et al. (2025)；Xie et al. (2025) 来评估多智能体系统抵御来自恶意智能体的外部攻击的韧性。 具体而言，我们考虑三类对抗攻击：角色提示攻击、任务提示攻击和输出攻击。

sents.en: We construct adversarial attack scenarios He et al. (2025) ; Xie et al.
sents.zh: 我们构建对抗攻击场景 He et al. (2025)；Xie et al.

sents.en: (2025) to evaluate the resilience of multi-agent systems against external attacks from malicious agents.
sents.zh: (2025) 来评估多智能体系统抵御来自恶意智能体的外部攻击的韧性。

sents.en: Specifically, we consider three classes of adversarial attacks: role prompt attack, task prompt attack, and output attack.
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们考虑三类对抗攻击：角色提示攻击、任务提示攻击和输出攻击。

paragraphs.en: Role Prompt Attack occurs when a malicious agent tampers with an agent’s role definition, inducing role drift and disrupting coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 角色提示攻击（Role Prompt Attack）发生在恶意智能体篡改智能体的角色定义时，会引发角色漂移并破坏协作。

paragraphs.en: Task Prompt Attack occurs when a malicious agent modifies task instructions so that the agent produces plausible-looking outputs containing targeted errors.
paragraphs.zh: 当恶意智能体篡改任务指令，使智能体产生看似合理但包含定向错误的输出时，就会发生任务提示攻击（Task Prompt Attack）。

paragraphs.en: Output Attack occurs when a malicious agent intercepts and alters generated artifacts of an agent before they are consumed by subsequent agents.
paragraphs.zh: 输出攻击发生在恶意智能体拦截并篡改某个智能体生成的产物之后、且这些产物尚未被后续智能体消费之时。

paragraphs.en: Each agent is independently targeted with a probability of 20%, consistent with the prompt chaos scenario setting. Examples of each adversarial attack scenario are illustrated in Figure 10 .
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体以 20% 的概率被独立选中，这与提示词混沌场景设定一致。 每个对抗性攻击场景的示例见图 10。

sents.zh: 每个智能体以 20% 的概率被独立选中，这与提示词混沌场景设定一致。

sents.en: We define two scenarios: execution failure and noisy response.
sents.zh: 我们定义了两种场景：执行失败和噪声响应。

paragraphs.en: Execution Failure simulates failed tool execution by replacing the original response with This Service is not available. , indicating that the service returned no valid output. This reflects cases where the tool server is unavailable, the endpoint is unreachable, or the backend raises an exception.

paragraphs.en: To verify MA-Mesh in real-world cloud-native settings, we extend our chaos evaluation to a Kubernetes-based deployment environment. Specifically, we deploy each task-executing agent as an isolated Kubernetes Pod in AIOpsLab Chen et al. (2025) and inject faults using the Chaos Mesh platform Chaos Mesh (2021) . Following chaos engineering practice, we construct three infrastructure-level chaos scenarios— Stress Chaos , Disk I/O Chaos , and Network Chaos . Stress Chaos emulates resource exhaustion in Pods. When a Pod is selected, CPU and memory pressure is injected during task execution, which delays agent responses, triggers execution timeouts, or causes failures. This scenario evaluates whether the multi-agent system can maintain task continuity when part of its agent population experiences compute-resource degradation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在真实世界的云原生环境中验证 MA-Mesh，我们将混沌评估扩展到基于 Kubernetes 的部署环境。 具体而言，我们将每个执行任务的智能体部署为 AIOpsLab Chen et al. 中一个隔离的 Kubernetes Pod。 (2025)，并使用 Chaos Mesh 平台 Chaos Mesh (2021) 注入故障。 遵循混沌工程实践，我们构建了三个基础设施级别的混沌场景——Stress Chaos（压力混沌）、Disk I/O Chaos（磁盘 I/O 混沌）和 Network Chaos（网络混沌）。 Stress Chaos 模拟 Pod 中的资源耗尽。 当某个 Pod 被选中时，在任务执行期间注入 CPU 和内存压力，这会导致智能体响应延迟、触发执行超时或引发失败。 该场景评估多智能体系统在部分智能体遭受计算资源退化时，能否保持任务的连续性。

paragraphs.en: [c] AgentVerse Chen et al. (2024b) is an autonomous multi-agent baseline with a dynamic expert-recruitment mechanism. It organizes problem solving into 4 stages. In the Expert Recruitment stage, a recruiter agent selects task-specific expert roles based on the current task. In the Collaborative Decision-Making stage, the recruited experts discuss the task to determine a solution. In the Action Execution stage, the selected agents execute the agreed solution. In the Evaluation stage, an evaluator assesses the outcome and provides feedback on whether to proceed with further recruitment. If the task remains unsolved, the workflow returns to Expert Recruitment with refined agent roles; otherwise, it terminates. Following the original implementation, we set the number of recruited experts per benchmark: 4 4 for software development and 2 2 each for tool use and scientific reasoning. We cap the recruiting rounds at 2.

paragraphs.en: [c] EvoMAC Hu et al. (2025b) adopts a self-evolving multi-agent collaboration (MAC) network specifically tailored for software development. The network updates its coordination structure via textual backpropagation, converting unit-test execution results into textual gradients to refine agent prompts and workflows. It comprises three teams. The Coding team decomposes the task into sub-tasks and builds a coding MAC network where Programmer agents generate code for each sub-task. The Testing team analogously builds a testing MAC network that generates unit tests. Then, a compiler executes the code and tests to produce execution logs. In the Updating team, a Gradient agent inspects these logs to identify completed, erroneous, and missing sub-tasks, and an Updating agent revises the network accordingly. Following the original implementation, we cap the coding MAC network iteration at 2.
paragraphs.zh: [c] EvoMAC（Hu 等人） (2025b) 采用了一种专为软件开发定制的自进化多智能体协作（MAC）网络。 该网络通过文本反向传播更新其协调结构，将单元测试执行结果转化为文本梯度，以优化智能体提示词和工作流。 它由三个团队组成。 编码团队将任务分解为子任务，并构建一个编码 MAC 网络，其中程序员（Programmer）智能体为每个子任务生成代码。 测试团队类似地构建一个生成单元测试的测试 MAC 网络。 然后，编译器执行代码和测试以生成执行日志。 在更新团队中，梯度（Gradient）智能体检查这些日志以识别已完成、出错和缺失的子任务，而更新（Updating）智能体据此对网络进行修订。 按照原始实现，我们将编码 MAC 网络的迭代次数上限设为 2。

paragraphs.en: [d] C+I Huang et al. (2025) is a resilient multi-agent baseline that augments an existing multi-agent system with correction mechanisms, introducing a Challenger and an Inspector to improve robustness against faulty agents. The Challenger is a mechanism attached to each agent: before performing its own task, the agent challenges other agents’ outputs and requests rewriting or re-execution when they are judged unsafe. The Inspector is a separate agent that intercepts messages exchanged among agents, checks for errors or unsafe behaviors using the conversation history, and rewrites them when correction is needed. Following the original implementation, we apply both mechanisms on top of MetaGPT for software development and LLM-Debate for the others, and cap the Challenger and Inspector rounds at 2 per agent.
paragraphs.zh: [d] C+I Huang 等人 (2025) 提出了一个具有韧性的多智能体基线，通过引入挑战者和检查者两种纠错机制来增强现有的多智能体系统，从而提升对故障智能体的鲁棒性。 挑战者是附加在每个智能体上的一种机制：在执行自身任务之前，智能体会挑战其他智能体的输出，并在判定其不安全时要求重写或重新执行。 检查者是一个独立的智能体，它拦截智能体之间交换的消息，利用对话历史检查错误或不安全行为，并在需要纠正时对其进行重写。 按照原始实现，我们在软件开发任务上将这两种机制应用于 MetaGPT 之上，在其他任务上应用于 LLM-Debate 之上，并将每个智能体的挑战者和检查者轮数上限设为 2。

paragraphs.en: Resilient proxy: cross-agent reflection. The orchestrator generates cross-agent reflection policies, each comprising three components: (i) a reflection source, namely a resilient proxy that performs the evaluation on behalf of its associated agent, (ii) a reflection target (agent), whose output is subject to evaluation, and (iii) reflection criteria, which define the evaluation standards from the perspective of the reflecting agent’s role. The cross-agent reflection enables role-aware evaluation, whereby resilient proxies assess peer agents’ outputs according to the functional requirements and expectations of their associated roles. For example, in a web development task, when an Architect agent produces a design document, the resilient proxy associated with a Backend Developer evaluates the document for backend completeness (e.g., API routes and data schemas), while the resilient proxy associated with a Frontend Developer evaluates the same output for frontend completeness (e.g., HTML templates and element identifiers). By aligning reflection criteria with actual inter-agent dependencies, this role-aware reflection enables precise detection of errors and inconsistencies before they propagate through the multi-agent workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 韧性代理：跨智能体反思。 编排器生成跨智能体反思策略，每个策略由三个部分组成：(i) 反思来源，即代表其关联智能体执行评估的韧性代理；(ii) 反思目标（智能体），其输出将接受评估；(iii) 反思标准，用于从反思智能体的角色视角定义评估标准。 跨智能体反思实现了角色感知的评估， whereby 韧性代理根据其关联角色的功能需求和期望来评估其他智能体的输出。 例如，在一个网页开发任务中，当 Architect 智能体产出设计文档时，与 Backend Developer 关联的韧性代理会评估该文档的后端完整性（例如 API 路由和数据模式），而与 Frontend Developer 关联的韧性代理则评估同一输出的前端完整性（例如 HTML 模板和元素标识符）。 通过将反思标准与实际的智能体间依赖关系对齐，这种角色感知的反思能够在错误和不一致传播到多智能体工作流之前对其进行精确检测。

sents.en: The orchestrator generates cross-agent reflection policies, each comprising three components: (i) a reflection source, namely a resilient proxy that performs the evaluation on behalf of its associated agent, (ii) a reflection target (agent), whose output is subject to evaluation, and (iii) reflection criteria, which define the evaluation standards from the perspective of the reflecting agent’s role.
sents.zh: 编排器生成跨智能体反思策略，每个策略由三个部分组成：(i) 反思来源，即代表其关联智能体执行评估的韧性代理；(ii) 反思目标（智能体），其输出将接受评估；(iii) 反思标准，用于从反思智能体的角色视角定义评估标准。

sents.en: The cross-agent reflection enables role-aware evaluation, whereby resilient proxies assess peer agents’ outputs according to the functional requirements and expectations of their associated roles.
sents.zh: 跨智能体反思实现了角色感知的评估， whereby 韧性代理根据其关联角色的功能需求和期望来评估其他智能体的输出。

sents.en: For example, in a web development task, when an Architect agent produces a design document, the resilient proxy associated with a Backend Developer evaluates the document for backend completeness (e.g., API routes and data schemas), while the resilient proxy associated with a Frontend Developer evaluates the same output for frontend completeness (e.g., HTML templates and element identifiers).
sents.zh: 例如，在一个网页开发任务中，当 Architect 智能体产出设计文档时，与 Backend Developer 关联的韧性代理会评估该文档的后端完整性（例如 API 路由和数据模式），而与 Frontend Developer 关联的韧性代理则评估同一输出的前端完整性（例如 HTML 模板和元素标识符）。

sents.en: By aligning reflection criteria with actual inter-agent dependencies, this role-aware reflection enables precise detection of errors and inconsistencies before they propagate through the multi-agent workflow.
sents.zh: 通过将反思标准与实际的智能体间依赖关系对齐，这种角色感知的反思能够在错误和不一致传播到多智能体工作流之前对其进行精确检测。

paragraphs.en: Distribution of Coordination Structures. As described in Section 4.2 , the LLM orchestrator dynamically selects among four coordination structures based on the goal of the sub-task. Figure 12 illustrates the distribution of coordination structures selected across four benchmarks. For GUI and web development benchmarks, MA-Mesh flexibly combines Sequential , Refine , and Parallel & Merge patterns. This reflects the nature of these tasks, where multiple UI components or functionalities can be implemented in parallel, while their dependencies, integration, and correctness are validated through sequential execution and iterative refinement. For GAIA benchmark, MA-Mesh exhibits a higher reliance on Parallel & Merge pattern, because its tasks are inherently amenable to parallel execution using multiple tools and independently solvable sub-tasks. For GPQA-Diamond benchmark, MA-Mesh mainly leverages Debate pattern, as scientific reasoning often requires analysis and verification from multiple perspectives through structured discussion. MA-Mesh also complements Debate with Parallel & Merge , as multi-domain questions can be solved independently.
paragraphs.zh: 协调结构的分布。 如第 4.2 节所述，LLM 编排器会根据子任务的目标，在四种协调结构之间动态选择。 图 12 展示了在四个基准测试中所选协调结构的分布情况。 对于 GUI 和 Web 开发基准测试，MA-Mesh 灵活地组合了顺序、精炼以及并行与合并模式。 这反映了此类任务的特点：多个 UI 组件或功能可以并行实现，而它们的依赖关系、集成和正确性则通过顺序执行和迭代精炼来验证。 对于 GAIA 基准测试，MA-Mesh 更依赖并行与合并模式，因为其任务天然适合使用多种工具并行执行，且子任务可以独立求解。 对于 GPQA-Diamond 基准测试，MA-Mesh 主要采用辩论模式，因为科学推理往往需要通过结构化讨论从多个视角进行分析和验证。 MA-Mesh 还以并行与合并模式补充辩论模式，因为多领域问题可以独立求解。

paragraphs.en: Controlled Structure Comparison. To isolate the structure’s effect from task-specific factors, we force Debate on Web Dev., which is normally dominated by Sequential, and force Parallel & Merge on GPQA-Diamond, which is normally dominated by Debate. As shown in Table 17 , both forced non-dominant structures underperform in both Vanilla and Compound Chaos, indicating the importance of task-appropriate structure selection. paragraphs.en: To compare with a naive baseline under Agent Chaos, we evaluate retry-upon-failure, which re-executes the terminated agent. Since its original role remains valid, retry recovers substantial performance. To isolate the benefit of role diagnosis and refinement, we additionally evaluate DoS prompt injection, which induces repetitive generation and eventually triggers a timeout that persists under simple re-execution. paragraphs.en: Figure 13 qualitatively illustrates the behavior of the resilient proxy in MA-Mesh . The upper part of the figure shows a case of cross-agent reflection, where the architect agent’s proxy evaluates the developer agent’s implementation against the architectural perspective. The proxy detects an incorrect implementation of the clear_inputs function that inadvertently removes the listbox and provides feedback, enabling the developer agent to correct the error. The lower part of the figure shows role-based failover. Here, partial corruption of the architect’s role prompt leads to an incorrect system design that overlooks the input format. Upon triggering failover, the role prompt is reconstructed with explicit constraints on data formats and required fields, allowing the architect agent to resume correct behavior.
